title: Compositional random forest
abstract: arXiv:2611.14275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compositional data have been analysed in the literature from three main points of view: directly on the simplex, in log-ratio coordinates, and as directional data on the unit sphere. In this paper, we construct a random forest framework for compositional responses that accommodates all three. Random forests are ensembles of decision trees, and the split criterion determines how each tree grows. We use the log-likelihood gain as the split criterion and consider distributions defined on the different spaces in which compositions can be represented. The Dirichlet likelihood has been studied in the literature, but its covariance is fixed by its mean up to a single scalar, and its maximum likelihood estimator has no closed form. To obtain more flexible criteria, we use two well-known transformations. translated_abstract: 成分数据在文献中主要从三个角度进行分析：直接在单纯形上分析、在对数比坐标下分析，以及作为单位球面上的方向数据进行分析。本文构建了一个适用于成分响应的随机森林框架，能够兼容上述全部三种表示方式。随机森林是决策树的集成，分裂准则决定了每棵树的生长方式。我们采用对数似然增益作为分裂准则，并考虑定义在成分数据可表示的各种空间上的分布。Dirichlet似然在文献中已有研究，但其协方差在仅相差一个标量的意义上由均值决定，且其最大似然估计没有闭式解。为了获得更灵活的准则，我们使用了两种著名的变换。首先，平方根变换将成分映射到单位球面上，而现有的方向分布需要数值估计……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向成分数据响应的随机森林框架，以对数似然增益作为分裂准则，并结合定义在不同表示空间上的分布，统一兼容了单纯形、对数比坐标和单位球面方向数据三种成分数据分析视角。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a random forest framework for compositional responses that uses log-likelihood gain as the split criterion with distributions on different representation spaces, unifying the simplex, log-ratio, and unit-sphere directional perspectives for analyzing compositional data.
